intro: A personal journal by Sunita Avadhani — travel notes, thoughtful stories and little things worth remembering, from Brisbane and beyond.
biography: Welcome to Kanasu, a personal space for stories, travel memories and reflections. Sunita Avadhani is based in Brisbane, Queensland, Australia, with stories connected to Sirsi and Karnataka, India, and places across Australia. More about Sunita will be added here in her own words.
